updates.title: CVE-2026-49179 Windows Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution
updates.summary: A command injection vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthorized attackers to execute code remotely over the network. This is a critical vulnerability affecting identity infrastructure and requires immediate patching to prevent unauthorized access and compromise of domain controllers.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62827 & CVE-2026-63512 SharePoint Server Authorization Vulnerabilities
updates.summary: Two authorization vulnerabilities in Microsoft SharePoint Server allow authenticated attackers to escalate privileges and tamper with content over the network. These vulnerabilities could enable unauthorized modification of sensitive data and unauthorized access to restricted content.

updates.title: Windows Hello for Business & macOS Platform SSO as MFA Second Factor
updates.summary: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO can now independently satisfy multifactor authentication requirements, eliminating the need for users to register a separate passkey for step-up authentication and policy-driven prompts. This change streamlines passwordless adoption while maintaining strong security posture.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Role Groups UI Enhancements
updates.summary: The Purview role groups management interface now supports permission lookup by role and membership, improving the admin experience when auditing and configuring Purview RBAC assignments. This simplifies the process of understanding role permissions and group compositions across the compliance platform.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot in Government Clouds
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention controls for Microsoft 365 Copilot now extend to government cloud environments, preventing sensitive data in prompts from being processed or used for model grounding. This enables organizations in regulated sectors to safely integrate AI capabilities without risking data exfiltration.

updates.title: DLP Block External Domain/User Action for SharePoint & OneDrive
updates.summary: DLP policies in Microsoft Purview can now block file access by specific external domains or individual users on SharePoint and OneDrive, providing granular control over sensitive document sharing. This enhancement prevents accidental exposure and strengthens compliance with data residency and access control policies.

updates.title: DLP Count of Labeled Documents Condition for Exchange Online
updates.summary: A new DLP policy condition for Exchange Online evaluates the number of sensitivity-labeled attachments in emails and triggers enforcement actions when the count exceeds a threshold. This enables detection of bulk data exfiltration attempts where multiple individually-low-risk files collectively represent significant compliance risk.

updates.title: DLP User-Based Aggregation of Alerts
updates.summary: DLP alerts can now be consolidated by user entity even when multiple policy rules are matched, reducing alert noise and simplifying investigation workflows. This improvement helps security teams focus on patterns of user behavior rather than individual rule matches.

updates.title: DLP Reusable Global List for Exchange Online
updates.summary: Administrators can now centralize management of keywords, domains, and email addresses in reusable lists that apply across multiple DLP rules, eliminating duplication and reducing the overhead of maintaining large policy sets. This improves consistency and makes policy updates more efficient.

updates.title: Endpoint DLP Support for FTP and SFTP
updates.summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now extends protection to FTP and SFTP file transfers from managed endpoints, giving organizations visibility and control over sensitive data moving through these legacy protocols. This closes a common data exfiltration path in hybrid and on-premises environments.

updates.title: eDiscovery In-Product Diagnostics for Common Issues
updates.summary: Self-service diagnostics in eDiscovery (Premium) help admins identify and resolve configuration issues related to case permissions, security filters, and policy status without escalating to support. This reduces the time to remediate common problems and improves case readiness.

updates.title: eDiscovery Premium Hold Reports
updates.summary: Out-of-the-box reports in the Purview compliance portal now provide aggregated information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases, with sorting, filtering, and export capabilities. This enhances audit trails and simplifies hold compliance tracking for legal teams.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Hard Delete for OneDrive & SharePoint
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now configure retention policies to permanently delete content from OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows, moving beyond the 93-day recycle bin retention. This provides stronger control over data destruction timelines while including safeguards to prevent accidental loss.

updates.title: Data Security Posture Management Agent for Sensitive Data Discovery
updates.summary: The Data Security Posture Agent uses natural language processing and large language models to discover sensitive data across documents, emails, and messages, enabling more sophisticated risk assessment beyond traditional keyword and information-type matching. This helps organizations identify emerging risks and data exposure patterns proactively.

updates.title: DLP Integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access for Network Interception
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention can now integrate with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, enabling enforcement of DLP policies on sensitive data flowing through browsers, APIs, and untrusted cloud applications. This extends DLP beyond traditional SaaS applications to legacy and shadow cloud usage.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now consolidates classic alerts and AI-triaged alerts into a single unified dashboard, allowing analysts to preview agent summaries and user details without switching interfaces. This streamlines triage and investigation workflows while improving context visibility.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Expanded User Profile Signals from Entra
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management alerts now display enriched user profile information from Microsoft Entra including office location, employee type, department, and last working date, providing investigators with critical context for risk assessment. This integration helps correlate insider threats with organizational changes and user status.
